title: Legislative Transitions & Checks
goal: Express institutional shifts and agenda transitions with pasar a + infinitive

items: I can use pasar a + passive infinitive and institutional phrases (pasar a formar parte de, pasar a depender de).
I can use pasemos a + infinitive to guide a civic assembly to the next item on its agenda.
I can use legislative-term, bill, veto, and separation-of-powers vocabulary in C1 prose.
